prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless repeating drawing-paper texture for an editorial art-history website.
Primary request: Generate a perfectly seamless, tileable, flat fine warm ivory drawing paper texture. Highest available resolution, ideally 2048 by 2048 pixels, square. Uniform warm ivory base very close to hex #f1eee5. Subtle organic fine paper fiber grain, tiny natural fibers, and only extremely faint gentle crease marks. The entire image is the paper material viewed directly from above, evenly lit and opaque.
Composition: edge-to-edge continuous texture; the left edge must match the right edge and top must match bottom so tiling is invisible. Fine grain at a scale appropriate for premium sketch paper. Subtle variation but quiet enough to put website typography over it.
Constraints: clean ivory; no objects, no text, no graphite marks, no artwork, no vignette, no border, no shadows, no stains, no dark creases, no pronounced crumpling, no deckled edges, no frame, no watermark. Flat lighting. Opaque background.
